units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:8">Y. Bicc. II, 64ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 3:9">Treat. S’maḥ. III, 9</cite> <he>לשנים מיתה של ב׳</he> death after two days’ sickness is a shocking death.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:11:4">Y. B. Mets. II, end, 8ᵈ</cite> a rending of garments <he>שאינו של ב׳ וכ׳</he> which is not done under the influence of the first shock (after the sad news) is considered as if not performed at all.—Pl. <he>בֶּהָלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:1">Num. R. s. 11</cite>; Tanḥ. Naso, 10 <he>באנגריא ובב׳</he> as a forced duty and in a hurried manner; a. fr.
